set_viewer(viewer: Any | None) → None¶

Bind the Napari viewer used to populate layer-selection combo boxes.

set_expanded(expanded: bool) → None¶

Fill remaining dock height when visible; collapse when hidden.

set_script(script_name: str) → None¶

Rebuild the form for script_name’s registered pipeline stages and CLI parameters.

_clear_form() → None¶

Remove every stage-row and parameter widget from the form.

_build_stage_rows(stages: tuple[nvitk.gui.pipeline.stages.PipelineStageSpec, Ellipsis]) → None¶

Add one enable-checkbox group box (with an empty inputs sub-form) per stage in stages.

_build_param_fields(script_name: str, pipeline_def: nvitk.gui.pipeline.stages.PipelineStageDef) → None¶

Build a form row (checkbox for flags, line edit with optional file/dir browse button otherwise) for every visible CLI parameter of script_name’s Click command.

_enabled_stages() → dict[str, bool]¶

{stage_id: is_checked} for every stage row in the form.

_layer_names() → list[str]¶

Names of every layer in the bound viewer, or [] if no viewer is bound.

refresh_layer_combos() → None¶

Repopulate every layer-selection combo box (and active-layer labels) with the current viewer layer names, preserving each combo’s selection where still valid.

_active_layer_name() → str | None¶

Name of the viewer’s active (or last) layer, or None if there are no layers/viewer.

_refresh_stage_inputs() → None¶

Rebuild each stage row’s input-slot widgets (layer combo boxes or an active-layer label) based on which stages are currently enabled.

_layer_selections() → dict[tuple[str, str], str | None]¶

Current {(stage_id, slot): selected_layer_name} mapping from every layer combo box.

build_layer_bindings(*, active_layer=None) → list[nvitk.gui.pipeline.stages.StageInputBinding]¶

Resolve every stage’s input slot to a concrete layer-name binding, given the current form selections and the viewer’s active layer.

build_argv(exe: str, *, active_layer=None) → list[str]¶

Build the full CLI argv for exe: enabled --stages, every filled CLI parameter, and resolved layer-input bindings.
